title: Dross's fractional triangle decomposition theorem
abstract: Formalizes the exact nine-tenths minimum-degree threshold for fractional triangle decomposition of finite graphs. The proof uses a finite max-flow/min-cut argument and induction that peels high-degree triangles.

informal.LeanPool.DrossFractionalTriangleDecompos: Every finite graph whose minimum degree is at least nine tenths of its number of vertices has a fractional triangle decomposition: nonnegative triangle weights sum to one at each edge.

classification.branch: extremal graph theory and fractional decompositions
